purpose: Test whether the local v48 Release source reproduces its own accepted-input/state prefix in the downloaded Gem Fields match and identify the first action divergence for trace nomination. The opponent is a fixed replay puppet; this is a source identity/prefix diagnostic, not a competitive result.
official_version_identity: unverified; timestamp/draft do not establish which submission binary produced the replay

original_artifacts.original_team_a_fuel_sha256: see exact team-a.fuel member in preserved ZIP; must verify before use

team_b_fuel.note: The saved bundle has no team-b.fuel member.

puppet_side: generate recorded team index 1 from this exact replay and run it as physical B; preserve its native draft picks and action script
steps: Decode the one preserved inner replay with decode_all.mjs --threads 1; verify the decoded input file and puppet draft against the original physical B draft.
Generate a team-1 puppet with gen_puppet.mjs in a dedicated isolated project; compare its requested script actions, then build that puppet using the existing runtime SDK without modifying other bots.

Run exactly one local Release game on maps/00gem-fields.map26a with candidate v48 on A and the fixed recorded-input puppet on B, fuel quantum 100000, jobs 1, nice 19. This is not a v47/v48 or v33 competitive cell.

Compare accepted native input sequence and round-start hashes to the original replay through the first divergence; record the first candidate-side actor/action and per-side fuel/status. Do not call an opponent-puppet full-match outcome a competitive benchmark.
proposed_match_manifest_status: not created or executed until root reviews a concrete generated-puppet project/build source pin and ordered candidate-A/puppet-B row
limits: Replay does not establish official bot version from timestamp or draft.
A fixed puppet does not adapt to counterfactual candidate actions.
Use the match only for source identity and first-fork nomination; real games versus frozen bots are outcome tests.
